KESTREL PAYMENTS — FOLLOW-THE-SUN OPERATIONS ROTA, WEEK 13/2026 (MON 23 MAR – SUN 29 MAR 2026)
Employee: Priya Anand, Incident Commander (L2), home office New York. Contract: Working Time Standard WTS-4 (applies to all incident commanders regardless of the office they cover).

WTS-4 (extract)
4.1 Minimum rest. Between the end of one shift and the start of the next there must be at least 11 hours of rest.
4.2 Maximum shift length. No single shift may exceed 10 hours.
4.3 Weekly maximum. Hours worked in a rota week must not exceed 48. A rota week runs from Monday 00:00 to Sunday 24:00 in the time zone of the employee's home office; a shift is attributed to the rota week in which it starts.
4.4 Measurement. All durations under 4.1-4.3 are measured as actual elapsed time. Shift start and end times are recorded in the local time of the office whose queue is being covered.
4.5 Breaks. Paid on-queue breaks are part of the shift and are not deducted.
4.6 Standby. Standby (reachable by phone, not logged in) is not a shift and is not counted, but a call-out during standby starts a shift.

decision.instructions: Does Priya Anand's week-13 rota, exactly as shown, comply with all of WTS-4 sections 4.1, 4.2 and 4.3?

criteria.false: At least one of 4.1, 4.2 or 4.3 is breached.
